name: Crystal Ward
label: Quest
description: Crystal Ward: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Pylon table allows you to combine green power crystals with red power crystals.
According to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to strengthen the protection you have against physical damage.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Arranging the crystals on the table, you carefully align the colors. As you push the last one into place, a burst of light fuses the crystals together.
The resulting combination is now yours.
